details: A selected STYLE_CONTROL/STYLE source pair binds through the generated complete AC1018 import and its group-1001 EED resolves to exactly one typed APPID row.
Changing the live STYLE height refuses the source query; restoring the exact value makes it pass again.
Changing APPID unknown71 refuses the source query against the immutable same-import APPID snapshot; restoring it makes the query pass again.
A half-length scratch copy retains the .dwg suffix, reaches BAD_READ_FILE_HEADER, and publishes no qualifying source bundle.
The same adapter then imports the untouched generated source into a fresh dx_data and rebinds the source pair and EED edge.

limitations: This verifies one locally authored AC1018 generated profile, not a producer-wide layout or support claim.
It does not qualify output ordering, recursive TABLESTYLE/LTYPE closure, native font rendering or independent consumer semantics.
No external or fixture DWG/DXF file was added to the repository.
